protocol.simple_composite: fixed equal additive corrections, no fold-label weight fitting
protocol.samefold_oracle: nonnegative simplex; current-fold labels; diagnostic non-deployable upper bound
protocol.strict_weight_path: only prior OOF folds; lexicographic worst-season then mean normalized Brier
protocol.candidate_pool_warning: Weights are temporal conditional on a frozen pool, but the pool is non-nested: f_transfer_w075 and lowrank_s300_r4 and other named configurations were compared post hoc.

fixed_equal_prompt5_corrections.definition: base + equal mean(candidate - base); equivalent to equal mean of listed candidates

fixed_equal_all9_corrections.definition: base + equal mean(candidate - base); equivalent to equal mean of listed candidates

fixed_equal_r_gated_plus_lowrank.definition: base + equal mean(candidate - base); equivalent to equal mean of listed candidates

diagnostic_samefold_convex_oracle.interpretation: If any fold's certified oracle ceiling is below 1100, no nonnegative convex combination of this candidate set can exceed 1100 on every fold.

strict_prior_fold_minimax_path.qualification: Weight fitting is temporally strict; whole candidate selection is not nested.
